description: A progress bar card for Power BI — show progress to target as a horizontal bar with the value and target labelled, ideal for project tracking, sales quotas, fundraising, or any metric where you're measuring progress toward a goal. Codex Progress Bar Card replaces clunky gauges and pie-chart progress indicators with a clean horizontal bar that's easy to read at any size. IDEAL FOR Sales quota dashboards (% of target reached) Project progress tracking Fundraising and campaign progress Service level dashboards (% within SLA) Operational milestones with a clear endpoint KEY FEATURES Configurable bar colour, background colour, and corner radius Target marker overlay Value, target, and percent labels Full font controls on every text element Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Hover tooltip showing value, target, percent, and remainder Click to cross-filter other visuals Minimal modern design High contrast mode support PRO TIP For "stretch goals" use two targets — a baseline (100%) and a stretch (120%). The bar fills past the baseline marker into the stretch zone, making overperformance obvious without changing the visual layout. Built by Nexus Codex. Part of a growing collection of premium Power BI visuals designed for serious dashboards.
